claim: 胜论为正统六派（Vedic schools）之一；与正理为姊妹学派，胜论以本体论为主业；两传统平行发展至11—12世纪合流为 Navya-Nyāya。
locator: S4（Vedic schools 列名）：'The Vedic schools (Mīmāṃsā, Vedānta, Nyāya, Vaiśeṣika, Sāṃkhya, Yoga)'；S1 导言：'the Vaiśeṣika (grounded in Kaṇāda's Vaiśeṣika-sūtra, c. 100 B.C.E., dealing mainly with ontology), developed in parallel until, at some point in the 11th or 12th century, they merged to form a new school, called "Navya-Nyāya", the new Nyāya or "new reason" school'
note: 两处均逐字核对（含弯引号形态）；早期正理一侧的同一句（Nyāya-sūtra c. 100 C.E.）已由 I01 包核读，本包只取胜论一侧。

claim: 学派得名于 viśeṣa 范畴是 S1 记录的一说。
locator: S1 §10.2：'The Vaiśeṣika traditionally and uniquely accept into their ontology a category of item called "basic differentia" (viśeṣa), from which, some claim, they derive their name.'
note: 'some claim' 措辞在正文与副标题中如实保留。

claim: 胜论范畴体系是对存在类型的系统分类；padārtha 词源为'词之义'，范畴是语言结构的形而上对应物。
locator: S1 §1.2：'The Vaiśeṣika system of "categories" (padārtha) is an attempt to classify in a systematic way all the different types of existent.'；'"padārtha" is the artha or meaning of a pada or word. The claim is that the Vaiśeṣika categories are in some way the metaphysical correlates of linguistic structures.'
note: 两处逐字。

claim: 七句义全列；前六为《胜论经》已见的古典目录，第七项（无）为后期学派增补。
locator: S1 §1.2：'Navya-Nyāya lists seven "categories" of object: substance (dravya), quality (guṇa), motion or action (karma), universal (sāmānya), particularity or differentiator (viśeṣa), inherence (samavāya), and absence (abhāva). Of these, the first six comprise the classical list of categories, found even in the Vaiśeṣika-sūtra, while the seventh (absence) is a distinctive addition by the later school.'；§11.1：'To Kaṇāda's original list of six categories (padārtha) or types of existent, they therefore add a seventh, "absence" (abhāva).'
note: 两处逐字；'motion or action' 为 S1 对 karma 的双语注记。

claim: 六句义总纲：六句义同异真实性之知是最上善之因；此知由自在天策励所显的 dharma 而得。
locator: S3 Pdhs_2.1(6)：'dravyaguṇakarmasāmānyaviśeṣasamavāyānām.ṣaṇṇām.padārthānām.sādharmyavaidharmyatattvajñānam.{5.-vaidharmyābhyām.tattva-}.nihśreyasahetuḥ'（GRETIL 校勘记夹注原样保留）；Pdhs_2.1(7)：'tac ceśvaracodanābhivyaktād dharmād eva'
note: 梵文逐字（GRETIL 明文以'.'作词界，此处规整为空格，字母未动）；注意该处拼写为 nihśreyasa（VS 开篇作 niḥśreyasa），照录。

claim: 九实列举；'唯此九者'；德十七加七成廿四；业五种。
locator: S2 九实经：'pṛthivy āpas tejo vāyur ākāśaṃ kālo dig ātmā mana iti dravyāṇi'；S3 Pdhs_2.2(9)：'tatra.dravyāṇi.pṛthivyaptejovāyvākāśakāladigātmamanāṃsi.sāmānyaviśeṣasaṃjñayoktāni.{5.saṃjñoktāni}.navaiveti'（navaiveti=navaiva iti，句尾 iti=thus；校勘记夹注原样保留）；S3 Pdhs_2.2(10)：'kaṇṭhoktāḥ saptadaśa'与'evam caturviṃśatir guṇāḥ'；S3 Pdhs_2.2(11)：'utkṣepaṇāpakṣepaṇākuñcanaprasāraṇagamanāni pañcaiva karmāṇi'；S1 §1.2：'there are nine types of substance, twenty four types of quality, etc.'
note: 梵文与英文均逐字；'twenty four' 在 S1 原文即分写，照录。
uncertainty: 十七德名目已在 S2 十七德经逐字核对（rūparasagandhasparśāḥ saṃkhyāḥ parimāṇāni pṛthaktvaṃ saṃyogavibhāgau paratvāparatve buddhayaḥ sukhaduḥkhe icchādveṣau prayatnaś ca guṇāḥ）；后加七德的逐项名目因 GRETIL 明文疑有讹形，不逐项列举（见 evidenceLimits 第11条）。

claim: 普遍定义：anuvṛttipratyayakāraṇam；最普遍者为 sattā；TS 82 三条件定义。
locator: S3 Pdhs_2.2(11)：'sāmānyam dvividham param aparam cānuvṛttipratyayakāraṇam / tatra param sattā, mahāviṣayatvāt sā cānuvṛtter eva hetutvāt sāmānyam eva / dravyatvādyaparam, alpaviṣayatvāt'（词界点规整为空格，'/'为原书偈颂分隔）；S1 §10.1：'A universal is something which is (i) eternal, (ii) unitary, and (iii) located in a plurality of things (substances, qualities or motions). (TS 82)'
note: 梵文与英文逐字。

claim: 特殊定义：住于永恒实体、为终极区分者；TS 83 定义；内属定义与因果界定。
locator: S3 Pdhs_2.2(13)：'nityadravyavṛttayo.'ntyā.viśeṣāḥ./.te.khalv.atyantavyāvṛttihetutvād.viśeṣā.eva'（'为原文 avagraha 标记）；S1 §10.2（TS 83）：'"those entities which reside in the eternal substances [i.e. the atoms] and function as their differentiators are called viśeṣa"'；S3 Pdhs_2.2(14)：'ayutasiddhānām.ādhāryādhārabhūtānām.yaḥ.sambandhaḥ.`iha'-pratyayahetuḥ.sa.samavāyaḥ'（引号字符照录原文）；S2 内属因果经（kvs_7,2 段）：'iheti yataḥ kāryakāraṇayoḥ sa samavāyaḥ'

claim: 极微三特征与下行论证：三微/二微/极微；'须弥山与芥子'反无限分割；S1 评 question-begging。
locator: S1 §2.2：'The Manual of Reason (TS 10–14) repeats the conventional Vaiśeṣika theory that the first four substances (earth, water, air, fire) are each of two types, atomic and composite. An atom (paramāṇu) is indestructible (anitya), indivisible (i.e. non-composite), and has a special kind of dimension, called "small" (aṇu).'；'The Vaiśeṣikas call the smallest perceptible thing a "triad" (tryaṇuka) and claim that it has three parts, each of which is called a "dyad" (dyaṇuka).'；'The Manual of Reason's intriguing answer is that if such were the case then Mount Meru and a mustard seed would have the same size, as each would have the same (infinite) number of constituent parts!'；'An implicit premise here (articulated by other Vaiśeṣikas) is that the size of a whole is a function of the size, number and spatial arrangement of its parts. The argument seems to be question-begging, for...'
note: 四处逐字；注意首句 SEP 括注 (anitya) 与原典相抵——见 thinkers/1 之外的下一条与本表 uncertainty。
uncertainty: 'indestructible (anitya)' 疑为 SEP 笔误：S3 明言 'paramāṇulakṣaṇā nityā'（见 /school/cihai/8 与 works/1 对应条目），S2 7.1 段通篇论 nitya/anitya 之分。本包正文从原典写'极微恒常'，引 S1 时保留原文。

claim: 极微不可见的认识论证（原典）：大者以多体与色可见，极微以无体量不可见。
locator: S2 kvs_4,1 段：'mahaty anekadravyavattvād rūpāc copalabdhiḥ'（大者…被感知）与 'adravyavattvāt paramāṇāv anupalabdhiḥ'（极微不被感知）
note: 两经逐字；经号依 GRETIL 转写本（kvs_4,1.5/4,1.6 一带，标记对位存在一位偏移的读法歧义，故正文不孤证依赖经号）。
uncertainty: 经号依编本而异（evidenceLimits 第3条）。

claim: 运动理论：无接触时因重体坠落；磁石引针等由 adṛṣṭa 所致；普拉沙斯塔帕达起对运动作系统研究，可与 Philoponus 比较；vega 动量；创世论自风极微始。
locator: S2（kvs_5,1 段）：'saṃyogābhāve gurutvāt patanam'；'maṇigamanaṃ sūcyabhisarpaṇam ity adṛṣṭakāritāni'；（kvs_5,2 段）：'agner ūrdhvajvalanaṃ vāyoś ca tiryagpavanam aṇumanasoś cādyaṃ karmety adṛṣṭakāritāni'；S1 §3.3：'Beginning with Praśastapāda (6 th century C.E.), the early Vaiśeṣika authors took a rational and scientific interest in the behaviour of projectiles and other moving bodies. Their theory bears comparison with Philoponus' "impetus" theory'及'The Vaiśeṣikas therefore speak of a new force, "adṛṣṭa" (the "unseen" force), alleged to account for such motions.'；S3 Pdhs_5(48.19-)：'maheśvarasisṛkṣānantaram'…'pavanaparamāṇuṣu.karmotpattau.teṣām.parasparasamyogebhyo.dvyaṇukādiprakrameṇa.mahān.vāyuḥ.samutpanno'
note: S1、S2 逐字；S3 创世段为长句，本包引用其两处关键词块逐字（maheśvarasisṛkṣānantaram；dvyaṇukādiprakrameṇa mahān vāyuḥ samutpanno），中间省略处以…标示。
uncertainty: 'rational and scientific interest' 为 S1 原文措辞，正文原样转述并声明为 S1 表述；'可与 Philoponus 比较'是学术比较，非影响关系。

claim: 知识来源：胜论（与佛教徒一起）不承认圣言为独立量，把证言还原为推理；胜论在实在论阵营。
locator: S4 §6：'Vaiśeṣika among the Vedic schools along with Buddhists who of course impugn the "testimony" of the Veda reject testimony as an independent knowledge source, pramāṇa.'；'Vaiśeṣika and Yogācāra join together in seeing a hearer H's knowledge that p which other philosophers see as flowing from testimony as really resulting from an inference having as one premise that the speaker S is trustworthy and as another that S has said p, assuming that trustworthy people who know the truth communicate it faithfully, to conclude that p is true.'；§1：'Whether this be because it is (as say the realists, Mīmāṃsā, Nyāya, Vaiśeṣika) that it has the right origins in fact'
note: 三处逐字。
uncertainty: '胜论仅承认现量、比量二量'的正面表述以 S4 此两句为据（否定圣言量为独立量），未在来源中找到'二量'清单原句，正文措辞取'不承认圣言为独立来源'的否定式。

claim: 合流后新正理吸收并发展古典胜论形而上学；胜论范畴理论经《推理撮要》传承。
